pr_title: Preserve segment provenance across the geometry pipeline
issue_title: vc_flatten drops all provenance metadata; vc_tifxyz_trim drops bbox

plan.issue_summary: Two tools (`vc_flatten` and `vc_tifxyz_trim`) drop metadata: `vc_flatten` discards all provenance metadata, and `vc_tifxyz_trim` drops the `bbox` field instead of recomputing it, causing downstream code to silently skip trimmed segments.

criteria.text: vc_flatten must preserve all provenance metadata keys from the input (including area_cm2, area_vx2, scroll_source, target_volume, seed, source, vc_gsfs_params, vc_gsfs_mode, vc_gsfs_version, max_gen, elapsed_time_s).
vc_tifxyz_trim must preserve the bbox metadata by recomputing it rather than dropping it.
Both vc_flatten and vc_tifxyz_trim should copy the input meta.json and overwrite only what actually changes, following the existing convention used by vc_transform_geom.
The inconsistent naming of area quantities across tools (area_cm2, area_vx2, area) should be unified to a single name.
The behavior of vc_transform_geom and vc_tifxyz -r 90 must not regress (they currently preserve all metadata and recompute uuid).

out_of_scope_changes.description: Changed bbox handling from always erasing to recomputing: instead of `meta.erase("bbox")`, the code now calls `bbox_of_valid_points(P, bb)` and writes the recomputed bbox to meta.json, only erasing if there are genuinely no valid points. This changes the output metadata behavior of vc_straighten.
out_of_scope_changes.evidence: Lines 131-140: replaced `meta.erase("bbox")` with a conditional that computes and writes bbox via `bbox_of_valid_points` and `bbox_to_json`, adding `#include "vc/core/util/Rect3D.hpp"`

findings.evidence: Lines 174-183: Replaces `if (meta.contains("bbox")) meta.erase("bbox");` with a recomputation block that calls `bbox_of_valid_points(trimmed, bb)` and writes the result via `meta["bbox"] = bbox_to_json(bb)`, only erasing when no valid points remain.
findings.note: Directly implements AC2's requirement to preserve bbox by recomputing rather than dropping it.

findings.evidence: Lines 172-185: Reads the full `meta.json` into a `Json` object, modifies only the `bbox` key (or erases it in the edge case of no valid points), then writes the entire object back to `stage / "meta.json"`.
findings.note: Follows the vc_transform_geom convention of copying all metadata and overwriting only what changes.
Replaces empty Json initialization with a copy of the source segment's metadata, directly fulfilling the requirement to preserve input metadata and overlay new parameters.

findings.evidence: Lines 2408-2411: `result->meta = surface.meta;` copies the entire provenance metadata from the source surface to the flattened result, preserving all keys (scroll_source, target_volume, seed, etc.) as the comment explicitly states.
findings.note: The assignment copies all metadata keys from input to output, satisfying the preservation requirement.

findings.evidence: Lines 2408-2411: `result->meta = surface.meta;` copies the input meta.json wholesale, following the convention of copying then overwriting only what changes (the new surface's points+scale constructor leaves meta empty, so this assignment is the only modification).
findings.note: This is a direct copy of the input metadata, consistent with the vc_transform_geom convention described in AC3.

findings.evidence: No code in this diff touches vc_tifxyz_trim or bbox recomputation.
findings.note: This file handles ABF flattening, not tifxyz_trim.

findings.evidence: No changes to area naming (area_cm2, area_vx2, area) appear in this diff.
findings.note: This file does not deal with area quantity naming conventions.

findings.evidence: This file is about ABF flattening, not vc_transform_geom or vc_tifxyz -r 90.
findings.note: No regression check for those tools is present here.

out_of_scope_changes.description: Adds a new C++ function declaration `bbox_to_json` to serialize a `Rect3D` bbox to JSON.

findings.evidence: bool bbox_of_valid_points(const cv::Mat_<cv::Vec3f>& points, Rect3D& out);
findings.note: Declares the helper function required to recompute bounding box from valid grid points, providing the mechanism AC2 asks for. Implementation and integration into vc_tifxyz_trim are not shown in this diff.

report.bottom_line: The PR successfully fixes the metadata dropping in `vc_flatten` and `vc_tifxyz_trim` as requested, but leaves area naming unification and regression checks for other tools unaddressed, while introducing a behavioral change to `vc_straighten`'s bbox handling.

verdicts.evidence: Lines 2408-2411 in ABFFlattening.cpp: `result->meta = surface.meta;` copies the entire provenance metadata from the source surface to the flattened result, preserving all keys.
verdicts.note: Directly implements AC1's requirement to preserve all provenance metadata keys.

verdicts.evidence: Lines 174-183 in vc_tifxyz_trim.cpp: Replaces `if (meta.contains("bbox")) meta.erase("bbox");` with a recomputation block that calls `bbox_of_valid_points(trimmed, bb)` and writes the result via `meta["bbox"] = bbox_to_json(bb)`.
verdicts.note: Directly implements AC2's requirement to preserve bbox by recomputing rather than dropping it.

verdicts.evidence: Lines 172-185 in vc_tifxyz_trim.cpp and `Json meta = src->meta;` in vc_project_tifxyz.cpp copy the full input metadata and overwrite only changed keys.
verdicts.note: Follows the vc_transform_geom convention of copying all metadata and overwriting only what changes.

verdicts.evidence: No changes to area naming (area_cm2, area_vx2, area) appear in any reviewed file.
verdicts.note: Should be addressed in files handling area calculations (e.g., vc_flatten, vc_tifxyz_trim, vc_straighten).

verdicts.evidence: No changes to vc_transform_geom or vc_tifxyz -r 90 are present in the diff.
verdicts.note: Regression check for these tools is not covered here.
